title: The AIP Morning Brief
description: A daily briefing on asset investment planning, infrastructure capex, utilities regulation and enterprise SaaS — with opinions, scenarios and what it means for the numbers, plus recurring specialist guests. Hosts and guests are AI-generated voices.
author: AIP Morning Brief

gemini.style: Perform this as a calm, confident morning business podcast. Maya and Jordan are two sharp, friendly colleagues who know this industry well and enjoy discussing it over a morning coffee. Both speak with natural British accents. Tone: warm, relaxed and conversational, with genuine but understated interest — like a thoughtful BBC Radio 4 or Bloomberg morning chat, not a hyped-up show. Moderate, steady pace with natural pauses. Save extra enthusiasm for genuinely big moments, and use a more serious tone for risks. Recurring guest specialists sometimes join: Priya (regulation and infrastructure policy), Marcus (markets, macro and SaaS valuation) and Sofia (enterprise software and AI); they sound like expert, articulate, measured studio guests with natural British accents. Natural, unscripted-sounding delivery, never shouty or over-excited.
